summary: Evidence for this cycle is architecture-only (.strategy_claude/evidence.json is a MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS placeholder with generated_epoch=0, no trade_latency/infrastructure/P&L data), so no measured profitability, latency, or canary-readiness claims are made. Code review of learnerbot/ shows a chain-agnostic net-edge signal framework (cross_chain_strategy_signals.py) gating on fees/slippage/impact/latency-reserve, with a well-structured SHADOW->PROMOTION_CANDIDATE->CANARY promotion pipeline (strategy_lab.py, strategy_canary.py) that never auto-promotes. The main asymmetry found is between Solana and EVM: Solana's shared-signal adapter (market_feature_adapter.py::load_solana_market_features) hardcodes gross_edge_bps/liquidity/sellability to 0 (needs_quote_feature_adapter=True), unlike EVM's EXACT_QUOTE_AND_SIMULATION basis, and it is unconfirmed whether this placeholder feeds the SHADOW profit-factor gate or whether Solana promotion instead uses the real net_sol ledger in solana_sibot.py::evaluate_position. EVM also lacks an evaluate_position-equivalent single net-P&L-after-gas ledger, and lacks the per-stage latency instrumentation that Solana has via execution_latency.py/solana_execution_latency_patch.py. These gaps limit how confidently Solana and EVM economics can be compared chain-specifically, independent of strategy quality.
